notes.benchmark_set: 20 cases stratified across 1950-2022, identical for every model
notes.no_gold_annotation: §6.4's hand-annotated set does not exist yet, so these are ground-truth-free metrics, each tied to an observed failure mode. Downstream utility is measured separately by src/eval/representation_ladder.py.
notes.probe_latency_is_misleading: A one-line schema probe put qwen3-30b at 0.4s and glm-5-3-flash at 2.3s. On real extraction the same models take 15.7s/case and hang respectively: latency is dominated by OUTPUT length (~2,500 tokens), not by the model's nominal speed. Never screen throughput on a short prompt.
notes.schema_failures_were_our_token_budget: 11 of 26 models initially looked unable to follow a JSON schema. At max_tokens=3000 all 11 worked -- they are reasoning models whose thinking consumed a 120-token budget before emitting content. qwen35-27b spent 1,491 output tokens on a two-field answer.
notes.decision: scout for full-corpus coverage. The representation ladder already showed extraction is NOT the bottleneck (masked text 0.578 -> fact text 0.577), so coverage is worth more than extractor quality; maverick's attribution edge is then tested on a controlled subset rather than assumed to matter.
